property_mix.notable: Inner Liverpool suburb with 19th-century terraced housing alongside mid-20th-century estates. Mix of owner-occupied and rental properties.

locksmith_relevant: Victorian terraced stock dominates; many original locks and period doors require specialist key cutting and restoration expertise.
High rental/HMO turnover in post-war estates drives steady demand for lock changes and rekeying between tenancies.
Older council estates present worn hardware and corrosion issues; emergency callouts for broken locks common in wet climate.
